use IO.Std.write_line

enum Day is
    MONDAY,
    TUESDAY,
    WEDNESDAY,
    THURSDAY,
    FRIDAY,
    SATURDAY,
    SUNDAY,
si

enum Status is
    OK = 200,
    NOT_FOUND = 404,
    SERVER_ERROR = 500,
si

write_line("{Day.SUNDAY} = {cast int(Day.SUNDAY)}")
write_line("{Day.SATURDAY} = {cast int(Day.SATURDAY)}")
write_line("{Status.OK} = {cast int(Status.OK)}")
write_line("{Status.NOT_FOUND} = {cast int(Status.NOT_FOUND)}")
